mapper.select: /** com.khnp.pels.api.TstEventSelectList */ SELECT T1.EVENT_SNO, T1.EVENT_TYP, T1.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, T1.PAGE_NO, T1.PAGE_ADD_SEQ, T1.PDF_PAGE_NO, CASE WHEN T1.EVENT_TYP IN (3,4) THEN T1.EVENT_TRGT_SEQ ELSE NULL END AS STROKE_SEQ, CASE WHEN T1.EVENT_TYP IN (5,6) THEN T1.EVENT_TRGT_SEQ ELSE NULL END AS IMAGE_SEQ, T1.USER_ID, TO_CHAR(T1.EVENT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3') AS EVENT_DT, T2.POS_X AS STRK_POS_X, T2.POS_Y AS STRK_POS_Y, T2.STROKE_COLOR, T2.STROKE_WIDTH, T3.POS_X AS IMG_POS_X, T3.POS_Y AS IMG_POS_Y, T3.WIDTH, T3.HEIGHT, T3.FILE_URL FROM GE_MP_CHECK_EVENT_M T1 LEFT JOIN GE_MP_CHECK_EVENT_STRK_S T2 ON T1.EVENT_SNO = T2.EVENT_SNO LEFT JOIN GE_MP_CHECK_EVENT_IMG_S T3 ON T1.EVENT_SNO = T3.EVENT_SNO WHERE T1.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{value} ORDER BY T1.EVENT_DT , T1.EVENT_SNO

/** com.khnp.pels.api.TstEventStrokeByPageList */ SELECT T1.EVENT_SNO, T2.POINT_PATH FROM GE_MP_CHECK_EVENT_M T1 JOIN GE_MP_CHECK_EVENT_STRK_S T2 ON T1.EVENT_SNO = T2.EVENT_SNO WHERE T1.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{tstUnqKyVal, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND T1.PAGE_NO = #{pageNo, jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY T1.EVENT_DT , T1.EVENT_SNO
